scope: actual full-height pixel inspection of exactly the thirteen declared normal goalie ev png downloads from browser attempt 03
method: each declared original was individually opened with view_image and visually inspected from title through bottom footer; no crops, copies or replacement images were created
pixel_result: no consequential rendering defect observed in the thirteen declared originals
common_observations: each image has the correct player, goalie ev quantity identifier, native and display unit labels, multiplier, three plotted annual points and three annual sections for 2023-24, 2024-25 and selected 2025-26

display units are goals per 100 common on-net opportunities for stopping, percent for six raw probabilities, and percentage points for six focal-minus-neutral differences; multiplier labels are 1, 100 and 100 respectively
each annual section shows player/team, percentile, goalies, cutoff 300 min, cohort n=76/76/74 and incompatible peers 0

qualification and quantity support, included seconds, known excluded seconds, gap, prior-only status, inferred inputs, current-season information, prior season and elapsed-unavailable reason counts are readable

construction and method text preserves ev pooling, common-panel normalization, quantity-specific conditioning and reference; proxy, experimental-estimate, no-causal-isolation, no-calibrated-interval and conditional-danger uncertainty caveats remain readable

2023-24 and 2024-25 explicitly say numerical sensitivity was not assessed for that annual state; 2025-26 shows assessed sensitivity, remaining optimizer accuracy unknown and diagnostic-only thresholds

all three corpus hashes, method blocks and final publication/provenance and percentile interpretation footer render within the canvas; no overlap, missing annual section, clipped text, truncation or unreadable block was observed

nonblocking_findings.observation: raw json-like method limitations and findings repeat within each annual section and produce a very tall export; they remain legible and complete
nonblocking_findings.disposition: known generic presentation issue; no specified export height budget and no consequential defect inferred from height alone

limits: only these thirteen ev originals were inspected; no claim about pk exports, viewport captures or other downloads
sha256 values below are copied from the completed local browser receipt and were not independently recalculated from png bytes
prior machine csv/raw-value/svg equality was provided as completed context and was not rerun; pixel review does not independently establish arithmetic or scientific validity

browser attempt 03 remains failed at its final zero-network-failure guard on three unattributed net::ERR_ABORTED league requests; this review neither attributes those failures nor establishes browser or family acceptance
no source changes, http, browser, database, model, tests, build, process queries or directory scans were performed
